item.title: Explain Why You Will Arrive Late
item.prompt_text: Your pottery class starts at 2 p.m. Heavy rain has delayed the bus. You expect to arrive at 2:20. Tell your teacher where you are, give the new arrival time, and ask where to put your bag if the class has already started.
item.target_grammar: Now for the current situation, future forms for arrival, and if for the possible classroom situation.
item.target_structure: Say why you are writing, give a reliable estimate, and ask one clear question.

checklist.point: Give your location and the reason for the delay.
Ask where to leave the bag.
